output.review_comment: The implementation correctly makes all tests pass, including the bulk pricing behavior (600 units = 600 × 150 = 90000). However, the docstring describes graduated per-unit pricing where "every unit is charged at the price of the tier that its own position falls in," which would yield 120000 for 600 units (100×250 + 400×200 + 100×150), not 90000. The bulk pricing logic exists specifically to satisfy test_bulk_order and contradicts the documented behavior. Request changes to update the docstring to reflect that quantities exceeding the last bounded tier receive a flat-rate discount applied to the entire order.
